extraction.notes: All lines from the page 10 reconciliation, current quarter column. Subtotals tie: 134,988 + adjustments = 275,586 (FFO); 275,586 + core adjustments = 272,186; 272,186 - 16,330 = 255,856. Diluted FFO shares 119,392 thousand reproduce FFO/Core FFO/Core AFFO per share (2.31/2.28/2.14). Loss on investments uses the 806 net-of-tax figure from the FFO reconciliation (EBITDA table shows 1,024). Gain on embedded derivative classified as derivative_mtm. Mark-to-market debt adjustment (13) classified as debt_cost_amortization as the closest fit (fair-value premium amortization on debt). Legal and COVID-19 lines are dashes (zero) in 2023 and are included at 0. Redevelopment, revenue enhancing, commercial and other capex appear after Core AFFO (FAD section) and are excluded from AFFO. Recurring capex is subtracted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
